Class GaussianFitter

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.ALeastSquaresFitter
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.GaussianFitter
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFitStringGetter, IFitter
public final class GaussianFitter extends ALeastSquaresFitter
Nonlinear least-squares fitter for a 4-parameter Gaussian with baseline: 
y(x) = A * exp(-(x - mu) ^ 2 / (2 * sigma ^ 2)) + B

Parameter ordering

  • params[0] = A
  • params[1] = mu
  • params[2] = sigma
  • params[3] = B

Bounds / validation

This fitter enforces sigma >= DEFAULT_MIN_SIGMA by default using a parameter clamping validator. Optional bounds can also be supplied via GaussianFitter.ParameterBounds.
